changelog:
=== AKD PC SETTINGS AIM STUDIO PREMIUM EDITION v3.3.0 ===
- User Tier Tagging: Explicit VIP active tagging for Gist authorized users, countdown for active trials, and locked state.
- Instant Cloud Update Flash: Pulsating animated update alert banner and top bar notification upon new version broadcast.
- Super Smooth AKD AIM OPT: Upgraded anti-tremor smoothing curve and progressive anti-jitter damping for pixel-precise crosshair stability.
- Real-Time RAM Monitor & Dynamic Process Limiter: Working set memory ceiling limiter with continuous background watcher and 1-click standby purge.
- Background System Tray Integration: Minimize-to-tray background daemon maintaining active RAM limits and high-resolution timers.
- Clean Free Fire Config & Keymapping Auto-Reload: Removed redundant tabs, added intelligent emulator reload prompt upon keymapping saves.
- CyberSlider UI Upgrade: High-contrast glowing gradient pill sliders with dynamic thumb tracking.
- 100% Genuine Windows AppX Debloater & Restorer: True PowerShell UWP removal and per-app instant restore.
- Windows Services Optimizer (Free Tier): 19 safe gaming services with individual toggles and critical kernel protection whitelist.
- Hardware Telemetry Dashboard: Real-time active processes, threads, handles, and memory utilization.
- Encrypted Persistent Vault: DPAPI encrypted storage for user tweaks with 1-click export and import backups.
